plugins.name: biobank-20387-doc-expert
plugins.description: Expert for drafting, proofreading and responsibility-allocation of ISO 20387 / CNAS-CL10:2020 biobank QMS documents, management review and internal audit reports for the Biobank of the Second Affiliated Hospital of Nanchang University.

plugins.name: paper-research-team
plugins.description: Paper writing and evidence-synthesis team: a dispatch lead orchestrates topic design, literature retrieval, manuscript writing, Meta-analysis synthesis, and formatting delivery to produce submission-ready, evidence-based academic manuscripts.

plugins.name: clinical-translational-team
plugins.description: Clinical and translational medicine team: a dispatch lead integrates clinical data governance, pharmacovigilance, molecular design and compliance review to support clinical research and translational outputs.

plugins.name: meeting-protocol-team
plugins.description: Hospital ceremony and meeting affairs expert team: award seating plans, protocol compliance, document drafting and delivery QA.

plugins.name: bio-omics-research-team
plugins.description: Multi-omics bioinformatics research team: a dispatch lead routes each task by omics type and analysis stage to six specialists - data acquisition & QC, omics analysis, statistical & causal inference, functional annotation, visualization, and result reporting - collaborating across the full reproducible analysis pipeline.

plugins.name: limfinity-engineering-team
plugins.description: Limfinity (RURO LIMS) engineering team: a dispatch lead routes each task by capability and model tier to five specialist engineers - data integration, cloud backend & sync, miniprogram frontend, infrastructure ops, compliance & delivery - collaborating across the full sync / miniprogram / VM / documentation pipeline.
